title: An optimal control problem for Stokes-Cahn-Hilliard-Oono equations with regular potential
summary: This article discusses an optimal control problem for a phase field model of two immiscible incompressible fluid flow, incorporating surface tension effects. The optimal control problem is defined with a $L^2$-cost functional and subject to the constraints governed by a system of coupled Stokes-Cahn-Hilliard-Oono equations. In this model, fluids are separated by a dynamic diffuse interface of finite width. We investigate the optimality condition of a given control.
